Congregation decision is narrated in sections 2–3 (19467–19507), followed by petition 19509–19524 and papal concession 19526 onward; no independent inserted instrument. Historical title note 19415–19419 and correction note 19487 are retained. Complete sanctions and full/short dating 19630–19635 close before XXVIII 19638.
